acceptance: Each table must have field definitions and document-level source validation
Critical keys and history joins require row-level evidence and no false orphan conclusions
Business and tax rules require signed-off scope and test cases
JAWAFA ONE screens must be tested with authorized data while financial records remain immutable
Live SQL reader must be verified with least privilege and private authenticated gateway
No production 90% declaration without independent review and evidence hashes
